newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Tenneco to sign Hungary power plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco to sign Hungary power plant deal.

text.p: U.S.-based Tenneco Energy will sign a letter of intent on Saturday to buy a 60 MW power station owned by Hungary's Dunaferr Rt steel company, Privatisation Agency APV Rt said on Friday.
APV could not provide with more details and Dunaferr officials were not available to comment.

Earlier press reports said that Tenneco will invest $100 million to increase the plant's output to 140 MW, in return for a 50 percent plus one share stake. When the capacity increase is completed, Tenneco's share will rise to 75 percent.
Dunaferr power plant supplies electricity and heating to the Dunaujvaros steel plant and heating to the town of Dunaujvaros, central Hungary.
